  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   --job-name=example
#   --nodes=1
#   --ntasks=1
#   --gres=gpu:1
#   --time=0-00:05:00
#   --partition=alpha
#   --mem=2GB
#   --output=%j.out

#flux: --job-name=example
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: --time-limit=5m

# Omitted Slurm option: --gres=gpu:1
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without a GPU, causing failure or severe slowdown.

# Omitted Slurm option: --mem=2GB
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: job may be scheduled on a node with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or degraded performance.

# Omitted Slurm option: --partition=alpha
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run on different hardware/limits or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted Slurm option: --output=%j.out
# Slurm's %j token (job id) is not portable in Flux output directives.
# Performance implication: none, but logs may overwrite/collide unless you choose a unique filename.

module load modenv/hiera GCC/10.2.0 CUDA/11.1.1 OpenMPI/4.0.5 PyTorch/1.10.0 tqdm/4.56.2

myworkspace="$(ws_find myworkspace)"

python "$myworkspace"/src/myscript.py
"
}

  "valid": false,

    "The original Slurm job requested 2GB of memory (`--mem=2GB`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; on systems that schedule/enforce memory this may under-provision the job and risk OOM.",
    "The original Slurm job specified a partition (`--partition=alpha`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/partition selection; on sites where this affects eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected."

}
